summary: Hotel compare ranks fee-inclusive nightly totals first and only uses average-rate times nights when a hotel has no nightly totals at all.
reason: RatePlanRate has no fee fields. Letting average*nights compete with fee-inclusive nightly totals under-ranks hotels and can pick a room-only plan over a cheaper all-in stay.
validated_outcome: internal/cli tests cover hotel-wide average fallback, mixed inclusive-vs-exclusive ranking, and payload currency.
